go up: Prices have gone up again this month, so many families are trying to spend less.
这个月物价又上涨了,所以许多家庭都在设法少花钱。
Charles Keeling: Charles Keeling spent many years measuring carbon dioxide in the air.
查尔斯·基林花了许多年时间测量空气中的二氧化碳。
result in: His careless driving resulted in a serious accident on the highway.
他的粗心驾驶导致高速公路上发生了一起严重事故。
George Hambley: George Hambley believes that global warming will not cause too many serious problems.
乔治·汗布利认为全球变暖不会造成太多严重的问题。
be opposed to: Many people are opposed to building a new factory near their homes.
许多人反对在他们的家附近建一座新工厂。
even if: Even if it rains tomorrow, we will still hold the sports meeting.
即使明天下雨,我们仍然会举行运动会。
keep on: Keep on trying, and you will speak English well one day.
继续努力,总有一天你会把英语说好。
on the whole: On the whole, the students enjoyed the trip to the museum very much.
总的来说,同学们都非常喜欢这次博物馆之行。
on behalf of: Our monitor made a speech on behalf of the whole class at the meeting.
我们班长在会上代表全班同学发了言。
put up with: I can't put up with the noise from the street any longer.
我再也忍受不了街上传来的噪音了。
so long as: So long as you work hard, you will pass the exam easily.
只要你努力,你就会轻松通过考试。
and so on: In the shop you can buy pens, paper, rulers and so on.
在这家商店里你可以买到钢笔、纸、尺子等等。
Mount Kilauea: Mount Kilauea in Hawaii is one of the most active volcanoes in the world.
夏威夷的基拉韦厄火山是世界上最活跃的火山之一。
burn to the ground: The old wooden house burnt to the ground within an hour.
那座旧木屋在一小时内全部焚毁了。
make one’s way: After the concert ended, we made our way slowly to the bus stop.
音乐会结束后,我们慢慢地向公交车站走去。
Mount Etna: Mount Etna, which lies in Italy, erupts several times every year.
位于意大利的埃特纳火山每年都会喷发数次。
Mount Vesuvius: Mount Vesuvius has not erupted for many years, but scientists still watch it carefully.
维苏威火山已有多年没有喷发,但科学家们仍在仔细观察它。
glance through: She glanced through the report quickly before the meeting began.
会议开始前,她快速地把报告浏览了一遍。
vary from…to…: The prices of these hotels vary from 100 to 500 dollars a night.
这些酒店的价格从每晚100美元到500美元不等。
Perce Blackborrow: Perce Blackborrow was the youngest member of the ship's crew.
珀斯·布莱克鲍罗是船上最年轻的船员。
Sir Ernest Shackleton: Sir Ernest Shackleton led his men safely back home after the ship was lost.
船失事后,欧内斯特·沙克尔顿爵士带领他的队员平安回家。
block out: Heavy curtains were used to block out the bright morning sunlight.
人们用厚重的窗帘来挡住明亮的晨光。
hoarse: After shouting for hours at the game, his voice became hoarse.
在比赛现场喊了几个小时后,他的声音变得嘶哑了。
Tom Orde-Lees: Tom Orde-Lees was good at skiing, which helped the team on the ice.
汤姆·奥德·利兹擅长滑雪,这在冰面上帮了探险队的忙。
seasickness: The rough sea caused seasickness among most of the passengers.
汹涌的海水使大多数乘客都晕船了。
bedding: They carried warm bedding with them when they camped in the mountains.
他们在山里露营时随身带着保暖的被褥。
Hussey: Hussey often made everyone laugh with his funny stories on the ship.
赫西经常在船上用他滑稽的故事逗大家发笑。
banjo: He learned to play the banjo when he was only ten years old.
他十岁时就学会了弹班卓琴。
perseverance: With great perseverance, she finally finished the long and difficult race.
凭着坚持不懈的努力,她终于完成了这场漫长而艰难的比赛。
give way to: The old bridge had to give way to a new and stronger one.
那座旧桥不得不让位于一座更坚固的新桥。
booming: The booming tourism industry has brought more jobs to this small town.
蓬勃发展的旅游业给这个小镇带来了更多的就业机会。
tactful: A tactful answer helped him avoid the embarrassing question at the interview.
一个得体的回答帮助他在面试中避开了那个尴尬的问题。
Frank Worsley: Frank Worsley was the captain who guided the small boat across the dangerous sea.
弗兰克·沃斯利是驾驶小船穿越危险海域的船长。
Hubert Hudson: Hubert Hudson worked as the navigator during the long and dangerous voyage.
休伯特·哈德逊在那次漫长而危险的航行中担任领航员。
give off: The burning leaves gave off a lot of thick black smoke.
燃烧的树叶冒出大量浓密的黑烟。
Lionel Greenstreet: Lionel Greenstreet served as the first officer on the famous ship.
莱昂内尔·格林斯特里特在那艘著名的船上担任大副。
changeable: The weather here is quite changeable, so take an umbrella with you.
这里的天气变化无常,所以随身带把伞吧。
sun-blindness: The doctors treated several explorers who suffered from sun-blindness in the snow.
医生们治疗了几位在雪地里患日盲症的探险者。
King Lear: Our class will perform the play King Lear at the school art festival.
我们班将在学校艺术节上表演《李尔王》这部剧。
disrespectful: It is disrespectful to talk loudly while the teacher is speaking.
老师讲话时大声说话是不礼貌的。
